segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had us down to cover the 50-seat plan, invoice timing, and the July go-live. Is that still the right list?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We have 42 current users and want 8 more for the support managers. We need access by July 15 if we're going to train before month-end.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay. For 50 seats on the annual plan, the pricing sheet puts you at $48 per user per month, billed annually. That totals $28,800 for the year, plus the one-time onboarding package at $3,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what you sent. Can you make the service term August 1, 2026 through July 31, 2027? Our budget starts in August, even if we start setup in July.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's fine. We can open the workspace on July 15 for implementation, and the paid subscription term starts August 1. The invoice would issue August 1 with net 30 terms, due August 31.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On the invoice, can it show PO 44719 and split the line items between subscription and onboarding?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Subscription as one line, onboarding as one line, PO 44719 on the header. For implementation, we'd schedule kickoff June 24, admin training July 8, and end-user training July 16. Does that fit your team?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: June 24 works. July 8, we may need 2 p.m. Central, not morning. Our operations lead is blocked until lunch.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: 2 p.m. Central on July 8 works. Also, the contract language is our standard annual term with automatic renewal removed, per your legal note, so it ends July 31 unless you choose to renew.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form today and I'll route it with the PO. If nothing weird comes up, we should sign by Friday.
